page.layout: Running head at top centre ("PARS PRIMA.") and page number at top right ("133"). Two medallion portraits with legends side by side at the top, full width. One column of text below them, two paragraphs. Signature "Kk 3" at the bottom right of the text block. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: PTOLEMAEVS Lagi filius, mortuo Alexandro Ma-gno, ab equitibus primùm, deinde communi omnium consen-su Ægypti rex declaratur, anno mundi 3640. ante Christum natum 322.huic Africæ, Arabiæque pars cum Aegypto forte venit: ex gregario milite eum Alexander virtutis causa eve-xerat. In Ægypto folerti industria magnas opes paravit: Ægyptios insigni moderatione in favorem sui solicitavit, & reges finitimos obsequiis devinxit: terminos imperij, urbe Cyrene ampliavit:tantúsq; factus est, ut non tam hostes timeret, quàm timendus ipse hostibus esset. Demetrium Antigoni filium bello vicit:captiuos,omnémq; prædam dimisit: se propter digni-tatem,non propter prædam pugnasse dictitans. Posthæc victor ipse à victo navali prælio vincitur: filium & fratrem atque amicos Ptolemæi captos, Demetrius pari antea munere provocatus, in Ægyptum remittit: donísque inter ipsa bella contendunt:tanto honestius tunc bella gerebantur, quanto nunc amicitiæ coluntur. Vide Justin.lib.13.14.&15. Legatos ex Alexandria misit Romam conciliandæ amicitiæ gratia: imperavit annis 40. Cyprum & Phoeniciam tenuit: ab hoc omnes alij reges Ægyptiaci, vocati sunt Ptolemæi.

BERENICE uxor fuit Ptolemæi prædicti, de cuius nomine Philadelphus eius filius, quam in sinu Arabico extruxit urbem, appellavit. Fuit & altera Berenice, Philadelphi & Arsinoes filia, quæ Ptolemæo Euergeti nupsit, cuius crines in cœlum relati feruntur, autore Conone mathematico.

page.notes: Medallion legends are transcribed as lines; the curved lettering of the right medallion ("BERONICE") is only partly certain. The 1-2 forms "3 6 4 o." and "3 2 2" are read as 3640 and 322. Spelling "Justin" follows the rule for i/j, the printed form is "Iustin". No marginal notes or catchword on this page.
